comparison.objective: Play a covered matching-pairs memory game by uncovering two discs per turn; unrelated to damper calibration.
comparison.physical_skill: Synchronized cover lifting/replacement, visual memory, and rule-compliant set-aside actions rather than precision tool use or dynamic tuning.
comparison.success_condition: Clear matching pairs; more than two uncovered, invalid removal, tipped cover, or loss fails; full score also requires open grippers. Numeric cover-placement tolerances are absent.
comparison.reason: Memory-guided bimanual uncovering is a different tested capability.
